features: All121 three-expert features; square-root feature subsampling per tree split.
motivation: Semantic-only81 recovers conversational concerns but causes excessive false alerts. Feature subsampling tests less binary-score dominance while retaining its discrimination.
configs: depth2/3 by leaf10/20;200trees;lr.05;seed982;five connected development folds
threshold: Full OOF and refitted development concern coverage; calibration never selects threshold
